summary: This overview outlines why Dragonheir: Silent Gods is worth playing, focusing on seasonal freshness, generous free-to-play summon rates, and visual hero designs. Seasonal rotations keep gameplay varied by reshuffling dual-element pairings each season and introducing distinct one-piece Mythic gear sets. Free-to-play players can obtain hundreds of premium Heliolite Dice per season through the Season Journey and daily events, easily exceeding 700 to 1,000 pulls. Top-tier heroes like Anneliesis and Serpentemis stand out for their supreme visual detail and gameplay power. Players are urged to stockpile 300 pulls for the return of Anneliesis.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.verdict: Must-pull / arguably best hero in the game
heroes.note: Ultra-premium Radiance unit whose limited banner requires saving up to 300 summons.

heroes.name: Auster
heroes.note: One of the creator's favorite AoE damage dealers and a cornerstone for Frost compositions.

heroes.name: Cervinia
heroes.note: A capable Lightning support that damages enemies and inflicts debuffs.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.verdict: Best Toxin hero in the game
heroes.note: The undisputed queen of AoE poison damage capable of transforming the battlefield into a toxic swamp.

heroes.name: Beldelle
heroes.note: One of the strongest characters in the game, utilizing Ice Crystal mechanics to deal heavy damage.

heroes.name: Fredegonda
heroes.note: Replenishes Ice Crystals for allies while granting powerful buffs and cold damage.

heroes.name: Hvitar
heroes.note: Serves as an exceptional Frost carry with high cold damage and execution on low-HP enemies.

meta_changes: Elemental affinity combinations cycle every season; Season 1 pairs Frost with Necrosis (Permafrost), Fire with Poison (Wildfire), and Lightning with Radiance (Resplendence).
Mythic equipment acts as 1-piece set bonuses that introduce unique, powerful effects every season.
tips: Save up to 300 Heliolite Dice (or Wyrmarrow converted at 100:1) to guarantee Anneliesis on her limited rerun banner.
Complete all 25 chapters of the Season Journey to secure 110 Heliolite Dice plus extensive Wyrmarrow and stamina rewards.
title: These 3 Reasons Will Make You Want To Start Playing Today! ⁂ Dragonheir: Silent Gods
